metadata.system: TraceGuard Adaptive Detection & Behaviour Analysis Engine

test_cases.name: Traffic Volume Spike Detection
test_cases.preconditions: Learned normal baseline envelope with >= 3 historical flows
test_cases.expected: Flag deviation with Z-score >= 2.5 and status DEVIATION_ALERT
test_cases.evidence: Byte Volume surged to 25,00,000 (Expected normal: 3,333.33 ± 942.81, Z=2648.11, +74900% deviation)

test_cases.name: Repeated Connection Blocks Periodicity Evaluation
test_cases.preconditions: Multiple repeated connections with irregular inter-arrival times
test_cases.expected: Assess timing variance without marking repetition alone as malicious
test_cases.evidence: Repeated connections exhibit high timing jitter (CV=1.04), typical of human interactive traffic or sporadic requests.

test_cases.name: Unapproved Ports Policy Enforcement
test_cases.preconditions: Approved scanner probing ports outside authorized port list
test_cases.expected: Record UNAUTHORIZED_SCAN_PORTS, withhold benign lookalike classification
test_cases.evidence: Scanner 10.0.50.5 probed ports [31337, 4444] not declared in authorized port profile.

test_cases.name: Vertical Port Scan Detection
test_cases.preconditions: Single host connecting to >= 8 distinct ports in 60s
test_cases.expected: Trigger Vertical Port Scan rule with observed distinct port count
test_cases.evidence: Source IP 192.168.1.199 probed 9 distinct destination ports across target host(s) [10.0.1.10] within 60s (Threshold: 8 ports).

test_cases.name: Horizontal Network Sweep Detection
test_cases.preconditions: Single host connecting to >= 6 distinct hosts in 60s
test_cases.expected: Trigger Horizontal Network Sweep rule with target host count
test_cases.evidence: Source IP 192.168.1.200 initiated connection attempts to 8 distinct destination hosts targeting ports [445] within 60s (Threshold: 6 hosts).

test_cases.name: Periodic C2 Beaconing Detection
test_cases.preconditions: Low jitter (CV <= 0.20) repeated external connections
test_cases.expected: Identify SUSPICIOUS_C2_BEACONING with interval metrics
test_cases.evidence: High-confidence C2 beaconing detected: Host 10.0.1.75 made 8 repeated connections to external target 203.0.113.88:443 at ultra-regular intervals of ~30s (CV=0.00, jitter < 20%).

test_cases.name: Possible Data Exfiltration Outbound Volume Inspection
test_cases.preconditions: Substantial outbound data (>500KB) egress to external IP
test_cases.expected: Categorize as Unusual Outbound Transfer hypothesis with non-ground-truth disclaimer
test_cases.actual: Stage: Unusual Outbound Transfer, Disclaimer Present: true
test_cases.evidence: Substantial outbound payload (15,00,000 bytes) egress to external host 198.51.100.55 (Investigation hypothesis based on observable telemetry patterns, not conclusive proof.)

test_cases.name: Spreading & Lateral Movement Fan-Out Detection
test_cases.preconditions: Ingress vector followed by fan-out to >= 3 internal hosts on admin ports
test_cases.expected: Trigger Lateral Movement rule with ingress correlation
test_cases.evidence: Host 10.0.1.30 exhibited spreading/lateral fan-out to 3 distinct targets [10.0.1.31, 10.0.1.32, 10.0.1.33] on administrative ports [22, 445, 3389] within 180s. Prior ingress connection from 192.168.1.10 observed.

test_cases.name: New External Destinations Baseline Evaluation & Gap Analysis
test_cases.preconditions: Learned normal destinations; host communicates with unseen external IP
test_cases.expected: Track typical destinations in baseline; accurately disclose absence of standalone alert rule in detectionRules.js
test_cases.actual: Typical Dsts: [10.0.0.10], Unique Dst Deviation Observed: True, Standalone Alert Rule Active: False (Documented Limitation)
test_cases.evidence: Host baseline observes destination set cardinality deviation; discrete per-destination IP alert rule is omitted from active detection rules.

test_cases.name: Scheduled Nightly Backup High-Volume Traffic Mitigation
test_cases.preconditions: Activity from 10.0.20.15:445 during 01:00-04:00 UTC schedule
test_cases.expected: Mitigate byte surge, suppress false alarm, assign MITIGATED_ROUTINE status
test_cases.actual: Status: MITIGATED_ROUTINE, Backup Mitigated: true, Anomaly: false
test_cases.evidence: Byte Volume observed at 85,00,00,000 vs expected 50,000 (High byte volume matches approved nightly backup profile; normal for configured schedule.)

test_cases.name: Approved Security Scanner Deprioritization
test_cases.preconditions: Scanner 10.0.50.5 active during 02:00-06:00 UTC schedule on approved ports
test_cases.expected: Apply 80% discount factor, reduce score to < 30, classify as benign lookalike
test_cases.actual: Raw Score: 75 -> Adjusted Score: 15, Status: DEPRIORITIZED_BENIGN_LOOKALIKE
test_cases.evidence: Source 10.0.50.5 matches verified security scanner (vuln-scanner-01.corp.internal). Activity from known asset 10.0.50.5 coincided with scheduled maintenance window 'Weekday Nightly Maintenance' (MW-WEEKDAY-NIGHT).

test_cases.name: Trusted Patch Server Distribution Mitigation
test_cases.preconditions: WSUS master 10.0.10.20 querying clients on authorized update port 8530
test_cases.expected: Mitigate alert score below 30, recognize authorized patch distribution
test_cases.evidence: Source 10.0.10.20 matches verified patch distribution system (wsus-patch-master).

test_cases.name: Periodic Infrastructure Health Checks & NTP Disambiguation
test_cases.preconditions: Regular periodic connections to corporate NTP server 10.0.0.5:123
test_cases.expected: Classify as LEGITIMATE_NTP_SYNC, is_suspicious = false
test_cases.evidence: Periodic time synchronization against NTP server (10.0.0.5:123). Standard network operational protocol (RFC 5905).

test_cases.name: Ordinary High-Volume Benign Traffic Alert Immunity
test_cases.preconditions: High-volume web requests directed to legitimate CDN endpoint
test_cases.expected: Zero false-positive attack alerts triggered
test_cases.evidence: Standard single-destination browsing correctly bypasses scan/sweep/lateral rules.

test_cases.name: Non-Suppression of Unrelated Anomalies on Trusted Assets
test_cases.preconditions: Approved scanner operating off-schedule and probing unapproved port 31337
test_cases.expected: Preserve alert, apply deviation penalty (+20 pts), withhold benign status
test_cases.evidence: Scanner 10.0.50.5 probed ports [31337] not declared in authorized port profile.; Security scanner 10.0.50.5 active at 2026-10-15T15:00:00Z (outside scheduled window 2:00-6:00 UTC).

test_cases.name: Source and Destination IP Column Normalization
test_cases.preconditions: Raw CSVs with disparate IP header names
test_cases.expected: Map accurately to canonical src_ip and dst_ip attributes
test_cases.evidence: Zeek id.orig_h/id.resp_h and Firewall src_ip/dst_ip both resolved.

test_cases.name: Port Parsing and Protocol Standardizing
test_cases.preconditions: String port and lowercase protocol in raw CSV
test_cases.expected: Integer dst_port and uppercase standardized protocol
test_cases.evidence: Successfully coerced port string to integer and uppercased protocol token.

test_cases.name: Unix Timestamp Ingestion & Chronological Sorting
test_cases.preconditions: CSV rows provided in reverse chronological order
test_cases.expected: Convert Unix seconds to ISO-8601 and sort ascending by epoch_ms

test_cases.name: Byte Volume Throughput Ingestion
test_cases.preconditions: Raw bytes_sent and bytes_received columns
test_cases.expected: Map to bytes_out, bytes_in, and compute total_bytes accurately
test_cases.evidence: Correct arithmetic sum computed.

test_cases.name: Missing Optional Columns Fallback Defaults
test_cases.preconditions: Omission of action, bytes_out, bytes_in, and duration columns
test_cases.expected: Supply canonical defaults (action: ALLOW, bytes_out: 0, duration: 0)
test_cases.evidence: Applied schema defaults cleanly.

test_cases.name: Safe Handling of Malformed Rows
test_cases.preconditions: CSV containing missing endpoint IP in middle row
test_cases.expected: Skip invalid row, parse valid rows, increment malformed_rows audit count
test_cases.evidence: Row 3: Missing critical endpoint IP (src_ip: 'undefined', dst_ip: '10.0.2.10'). Row skipped.

test_cases.name: Graceful Rejection of Invalid Timestamps
test_cases.preconditions: Row containing non-date string in timestamp column
test_cases.expected: Skip row without crashing, record audit error
test_cases.evidence: Row 2: Invalid timestamp format 'corrupted-time'. Row skipped.

test_cases.name: Canonical Schema Uniformity Across Dual Schemas
test_cases.preconditions: Dual-schema CSV inputs parsed into memory
test_cases.expected: All output objects conform to standard 11-key FlowRecord contract
test_cases.evidence: Checked keys: record_id, timestamp, epoch_ms, src_ip, src_port, dst_ip, dst_port, protocol, bytes_out, bytes_in, total_bytes

test_cases.name: Cross-Schema Detection Invariance
test_cases.dataset: Equivalent Attack Flows in Dual Schemas
test_cases.preconditions: Equivalent attack sequences represented in Zeek format and Firewall format
test_cases.expected: Trigger identical detection rules with identical distinct counts
test_cases.actual: Zeek triggered: RULE-NET-SWEEP-002, RULE-LAT-MOVE-003, Firewall triggered: RULE-NET-SWEEP-002, RULE-LAT-MOVE-003
test_cases.evidence: Both schemas triggered Horizontal Network Sweep and Lateral Movement identically.

test_cases.name: Zero Ground-Truth Leakage into Detection Logic
test_cases.preconditions: Port scan flows labeled as benign_standard_traffic in label column
test_cases.expected: Detection logic triggers based strictly on telemetry, completely ignoring label
test_cases.evidence: Detection logic operates with 100% blind telemetry independence from evaluation labels.

test_cases.name: Incident Aggregation by Host Entity
test_cases.preconditions: Multiple detections originating from the same source IP
test_cases.expected: Merge into single incident entity with combined evidence records
test_cases.evidence: Record count: 4

test_cases.name: Mathematical Scoring Breakdown & Critical Asset Bonus
test_cases.preconditions: Lateral movement targeting Domain Controller (10.0.0.10 in trusted_activity)
test_cases.expected: Award +15 HVA proximity bonus, escalate score into CRITICAL (>=85)
test_cases.actual: Final Score: 85, Severity: CRITICAL, HVA Bonus: +15 pts
test_cases.evidence: Base Adjusted Score: 70 -> Critical Asset Proximity (+15 pts targeting Domain Controller/Key Asset)

test_cases.name: Adaptive Context Replay Evidence & Delta Transparency
test_cases.preconditions: Incident generated with contextual discount applied
test_cases.expected: Preserve raw score side-by-side with adjusted score and exact delta rationale
test_cases.evidence: All raw flow records, timestamps, and packet metrics remain permanently preserved in forensic audit logs. No data was pruned or suppressed.

test_cases.name: Sparse Telemetry Defense (Insufficient History Handling)
test_cases.preconditions: Host with only 1 recorded network flow
test_cases.expected: Tag as INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY, suppress false alarms
test_cases.actual: Status: INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY, Has Baseline: false, Anomaly Raised: false
test_cases.evidence: Host 10.0.1.250 has only 1 recorded flow(s). Minimum 3 required for statistical baseline modeling.

test_cases.name: Host Traffic Deviation Visual Model Verification
test_cases.preconditions: Baseline envelope computed across 60s windows with observed surge
test_cases.expected: Feed 4 deviation metrics (Flows, Bytes, Dsts, Ports) with Z-scores to UI chart
test_cases.actual: Metrics Fed: 4, Byte Z-Score: 49.5, Is Anomalous: true
test_cases.evidence: Byte Volume surged to 50,000 (Expected normal: 3,333.33 ± 942.81, Z=49.5, +1400% deviation)

test_cases.name: Beaconing Interval Pulse Time Series Data Feed
test_cases.preconditions: Series of repeated connections with ~30s delta t
test_cases.expected: Construct discrete delta interval series and summary statistics (mean, median, CV)
test_cases.evidence: Delta t sequence: [30, 30, 31, 29, 30]s

test_cases.name: Incident Timeline Chronological Event Sequencing
test_cases.preconditions: Incident with flow records delivered out of order
test_cases.expected: Sort chronologically ascending, attach Reconnaissance stage hypothesis and disclaimer
test_cases.actual: Sorted Order: [f1, f2, f3], Stage: Reconnaissance
test_cases.evidence: Disclaimer: Investigation hypothesis based on observable telemetry patterns, not conclusive proof.

test_cases.name: Directed Network Topology Graph Model Verification
test_cases.preconditions: 1 source connecting to 2 distinct destinations (1 standard, 1 critical DC)
test_cases.expected: Construct 3 host nodes, 2 directed edges with weight scaled 1.5-7.0, zero phantom nodes
test_cases.evidence: Roles: [10.0.1.20:SUSPECT_SOURCE, 10.0.1.25:INTERNAL_TARGET, 10.0.0.10:DOMAIN_CONTROLLER_CRITICAL]

test_cases.name: Forensic CSV Report Export RFC-4180 Format Compliance
test_cases.preconditions: Incident list with numeric and string fields
test_cases.expected: 13 canonical columns, CRLF line endings, double-quote escaping per RFC-4180
test_cases.evidence: Incident_ID,Source_Entity,Prioritization_Score_0_to_100,Severity,Raw_Score,Flow_Record_Count,Duration_Seconds,First_Seen,Last_Seen,Distinct_Rules_Triggered,Is_Benign_Lookalike,Unexplained_Evidence_Count,Mitigations_Applied

test_cases.name: Standalone HTML Executive Report Generation & XSS Sanitization
test_cases.preconditions: Telemetry payload containing malicious JavaScript tags in entity fields
test_cases.expected: Render valid HTML5 document, safely sanitize script tags into HTML entities
test_cases.actual: Valid HTML5 Doctype: true, Script Tag Blocked: true, Text Entity Encoded: true
test_cases.evidence: Raw <script> tags sanitized to <script>; XSS vulnerability mitigated.
